body:
Ok yeah so I took a bottle of 20 15 mg dxm pills.  Let me tell you, this shit is not worth it.  What a shitty high.  My head was buzzing so much I couldn't enjoy any other effects, such as... A lightness in the body, I would move around and yeah kind of like an MDMA type lightness floating around shit.  My throat felt numb.  I puked pretty hardcore too.  I'd have major time lapses, like, my mom walked in the room as I was laying on the couch.  It was like BOOM SNAP she was in there out of nowhere type thing.  Snapshot type vision.  I really felt like I was gonna die or like have to go to ER or something for awhile, I suppose I was just panicking, but my mind and body was VERY uncomfortable with this shit being in me. Yeah...
